# @stackline/moment-core 1.0.0 reference

## Identity

- npm package: @stackline/moment-core
- package release: 1.0.0
- compatible runtime API: Moment.js 2.30.1
- canonical documentation: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/moment/
- versioned documentation: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/moment/v1.0.0/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@stackline/moment-core
- source: https://github.com/alexandroit/moment
- license: MIT

## Installation

```bash
npm install @stackline/moment-core@1.0.0 --save-exact
```

```ts
import moment from '@stackline/moment-core';

const parsed = moment('2026-05-22 14:30', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm', true);
console.log(parsed.isValid(), parsed.clone().utc().format());
```

The package preserves the mutable Moment.js programming model, CommonJS and ESM-friendly builds,
individual locale files, browser bundles, and bundled TypeScript declarations. Use it for existing
applications that require Moment compatibility; compare modern date/time libraries for greenfield
work when that compatibility is not required.
